descriptionNullable:
**Introduction**
The purpose of this dataset is to gain a better understanding of object detection and its applications in agriculture. The trained model, using YOLOv8 architecture and pretrained weights, can detect individual grape clusters. By detecting grape clusters we can use this data to build further models to detect other data such as disease or estimate yield. 

**Dataset Description**
Data was collected using an I-pad Air2 RGB camera. The camera has 8 megapixels and a resolution of 3226x2449. The data consists of ~100 images after preprocessing. The data was annotated using LabelImg. github: https://github.com/heartexlabs/labelImg

**Implementation Steps**
~~~~Data Preprocessing
Data was cropped via its bounding box extremes and then split into smaller images of a dimension of at least 1280x1280. (link to code pending). The data was split into train(80%) val(10%) test(10%)

~~~~Model Training
Model used the YOLOv8 architecture and default hyperparameters. Which can be seen on the [Ultralytics documentation](https://docs.ultralytics.com/modes/train/). The model was trained for 35 epochs.  

~~~~Evaluation and Inference
1. Evaluation metrics: Intersection over Union (IoU), Mean Average Precision (mAP). These can be seen in the folder ~/SplitImagesTrain/single_box_grape/results.csv
The score for the best: mAP50: .901; mAP50-95: .669
 
2. Model performance analysis and visualization of detected Pinot Noir grapes can be seen ~/SplitImagesTrain/single_box_grape/results.png
To view prediction JGS look in ~/SplitImagesTrain/single_box_grape2
To view a video of grape tracking and counting view the video: grape_track_count.avi

**Conclusion**
Using a small dataset a YOLO model can be trained to detect grapes in a given image as well as videos. Future work will encompass and improving tracking, segmentation and different grape varietals.
subtitle: YOLOv8 Grape Detection
